Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 cites exactly one physical page of the private snapshot of the Maryland Driver's Manual, the MVA's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: exact ages, hours, distances, durations and exceptions are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so that no learner line copies the manual.
Section notes: headlight distances, the slow-moving-vehicle speed and the work-zone light colors are exact values and are restated in their own fact blocks; the photo of the slow-moving sign and the work-zone light icons were not read as images, only their captions.
Accuracy flags: none beyond the open items in the VERIFY list; no page in the selected range was unreadable.
Stability: the manual is a single published revision whose edition is printed only on the copyright page, so any rule that a later law or revision changes must be re-read from the current edition before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
